channel.title: Warhammer 40k Community RSS Feed
channel.description: Latest intelligence reports from the Warhammer Community

item.title: Painting Traitor Ratlings! | Intermediate | Warhammer 40,000 Kill Team | Brutal & Cunning
item.description: The article provides an intermediate-level guide on how to paint Traitor Ratlings for Warhammer 40,000 Kill Team, focusing on techniques that capture their Brutal & Cunning aesthetic.

item.title: Kill Team balance update – Big changes to Chaos and beyond
item.description: The Warhammer article on the Kill Team balance update reveals significant adjustments to Chaos factions and other teams, aiming to enhance gameplay fairness and strategic diversity.

item.title: Kill Team: Brutal and Cunning – Snaffle snacks and snipe foes with the Ratlings
item.description: The article introduces the Ratlings team in the Warhammer game "Kill Team: Brutal and Cunning," highlighting their unique abilities to stealthily snipe enemies and their quirky penchant for scavenging snacks during missions.

item.title: Miniature of the Year 2024: Vote for your favourites here
item.description: The Warhammer Community article invites fans to vote for their favorite miniature from a selection showcased in 2024, with a link for participation.

item.title: Kill Team: Brutal and Cunning – Ork Wrecka Krews bring hammers to a rokkit fight
item.description: In the Warhammer universe, the Ork Wrecka Krews in "Kill Team: Brutal and Cunning" use heavy hammers and explosive rokkits, emphasizing their characteristic mix of brute force and unpredictable weaponry in tabletop skirmishes.

item.title: Sunday Preview – Kill Team gets brutal and cunning
item.description: The Warhammer article previews an upcoming release for Kill Team, featuring new, brutal and cunning expansions that enhance the game's tactical depth and diversity.

item.title: Warhammer 40,000 Grand Narrative 2024 LIVE – Latest updates from the warfront
item.description: The article provides the latest updates and developments from the Warhammer 40,000 Grand Narrative event for 2024, detailing key battles, character evolutions, and significant changes in the ongoing warfronts across the galaxy.

item.title: Painting Rogue Trader themed Wrecka Krew Orks | Intermediate | Warhammer 40,000: Kill Team |
item.description: This Warhammer article provides a detailed guide on how to paint Rogue Trader themed Wrecka Krew Orks for the game Warhammer 40,000: Kill Team, targeting intermediate painters.

item.title: World Championships of Warhammer 2024 LIVE – Updates from the tournament floor
item.description: The article provides real-time updates and insights from the 2024 Warhammer World Championships, detailing key matches, player strategies, and event highlights.

item.title: The first Kill Team quarterly update sets the stage for future adjustments
item.description: The first quarterly update for Warhammer's Kill Team introduces initial adjustments and previews ongoing updates aimed at balancing and enhancing the game.

item.title: Learn to Play – Kill Team
item.description: The Warhammer Community video "Learn to Play – Kill Team" provides a comprehensive guide for beginners on how to play the tabletop game Kill Team, which is a skirmish variant of the popular Warhammer 40,000 series, focusing on tactical squad-based combat.

item.title: Battle Report puts the Team in Kill Team with a Joint Ops grudge match
item.description: The Warhammer article discusses a Kill Team battle report featuring a Joint Ops grudge match that emphasizes teamwork and strategic cooperation between players.
